assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent PNG game-art asset for a Hearts of Iron IV postapocalyptic Khan faction focus titled Sky over Headquarters. Subject: a weathered heavy twin-barrel anti-aircraft gun on a compact four-legged stabilized field carriage, barrels elevated diagonally toward upper left, detailed riveted shield, elevation wheels, ammunition feed and working mechanisms. Three-quarter front-side view, imposing readable silhouette. No crew. No ground, bunker, sandbags, sky, smoke, muzzle flash, flags, symbols, labels or text. Dark gunmetal and muted olive paint, worn steel highlights. Semi-realistic richly painted military concept art, restrained cinematic cool light from upper left and faint warm edge accents, crisp clean cutout suitable for focus icon compositing. Entire gun including barrel tips and all carriage feet fully in frame, generous transparent margins, landscape canvas. Background genuinely alpha transparent. Single standalone gun asset, not an icon badge, not collage.

Generate ONE full-body standing military air observer, isolated on genuine alpha transparency, for a postapocalyptic Khan faction focus asset. Supplied image is ONLY a uniform design reference; translate it into detailed semi-realistic painterly military concept art, not low-poly. Match charcoal blue-black field uniform, dark rounded cap with burgundy band, burgundy standing collar, three horizontal steel torso armor plates on leather straps, brown leather belt and pouches, tall brown boots. Mature male observer in three-quarter profile facing left, tilting head and binoculars upward to watch aircraft; BOTH anatomically correct hands hold the binoculars at eye level. Feet firmly planted, complete full-body silhouette including boots and cap, relaxed practical stance. Realistic cloth and worn metal. Cool upper-left light and subtle warm right rim light. No guns, chair, lamp, flags, insignia, text, scene or floor. Transparent holes between limbs. No backdrop, haze or cast ground shadow. Generous clear margin. Single character only.

One isolated military anti-aircraft searchlight as a separate transparent PNG asset. Heavy round 1940s-style steel searchlight drum tilted upward toward upper left, on sturdy rotating yoke and compact tripod mechanical base. Three-quarter side-front perspective, readable circular glass reflector, worn olive paint and gunmetal bolts, power cable neatly looped on the base. Semi-realistic painted military concept art, same visual family as a weathered antiaircraft gun and dark-uniform observer. Reflector softly luminous ivory but NO projected light beam, no haze, no glow beyond the silhouette; the light beam will be added separately during composition. Complete object with all legs in frame and transparent margin. Actual alpha-transparent backdrop, no ground plane, people, props, letters, flags, icons or border. Cool highlights and faint warm metal edges. Single standalone hardware asset only.

composition_preview_prompt: Use case: compositing. Make one compact finished painterly strategy-game focus illustration for 'Sky over Headquarters' using these three reference assets, preserving their designs. Reference1 twin antiaircraft gun is dominant in lower left and center, its raised barrels lead to upper left. Reference2 full-body Khan observer stands in the right foreground with binoculars to eyes, charcoal uniform with burgundy cap band and collar and three horizontal breastplates. Reference3 searchlight is behind him at right, visibly separate, beam slanting toward upper left into a stormy night sky. Compose a cohesive dramatic diorama, triangular readable grouping, gun and man silhouettes not confused, complete observer boots and gun tips visible with margin. Background: distant low concrete bunker entrance embedded in a dark hill, small restrained warm door light, low sandbag protection and midnight blue clouds; only two tiny distant aircraft silhouettes high above. Searchlight beam frames the subject. Match grounded military painterly realism, gunmetal and charcoal colors, warm accents, high contrast at focal points. No text, title, frame, heraldic badge, modern logos, new foreground characters or oversized fantasy elements. Square canvas, focus-icon composition readable when reduced.
